title: SchemaRouter Design and Research Evidence Ledger
purpose: Machine-readable provenance index for reproducibility, follow-up papers, ablation reporting, and research-integrity review.
scope: Complete material design and experiment lineage from the initial repository implementation through the active 0.11 routing-quality cycle. Routine bugfix-only commits are referenced by Git history but are not treated as independent design experiments unless they changed an architectural invariant, evaluation protocol, or empirical claim.

legacy_evidence_inventory.note: Legacy files and their Git history preserve the earlier routing/holdout lineage. Later cycles below contain explicit freeze/run/artifact provenance suitable for paper-level reconstruction.

experiments.hypothesis: A MiniLM fast-path plus selective BGE reranking can reduce CPU latency while preserving preregistered quality floors.
experiments.failure_reason: Near-domain unsupported rejection was 94.792%, below the preregistered 95% floor by one case; candidate was rejected rather than retuned.

experiments.hypothesis: A typed schema graph can own routing authority while semantic signals provide bounded soft evidence, reducing latency without sacrificing quality/safety.
experiments.failure_reason: Natural near-domain unsupported rejection was 91.67%, below the preregistered 95% floor despite supported-accuracy and latency gains.

integrity_events.reason: Structural audit found reuse of development unsupported-operation families.

experiments.hypothesis: Fresh natural-language development data can expose the post-0.10 routing bottleneck without reusing consumed calibration/blind evidence.
Separating tool-domain selection from within-tool operation selection will improve exact-route accuracy while preserving rejection.
experiments.failure_reason: Wrong-tool errors were unchanged while wrong-endpoint errors increased, localizing the regression to within-tool operation resolution.

experiments.hypothesis: If operation-fit already identifies a registered route, allowing that accepted route to control the single-call candidate will recover endpoint accuracy without changing the abstention boundary.
experiments.failure_reason: Large endpoint-accuracy gain did not improve unsupported rejection or false-route rate, so the selector is useful only as one component of a safer composite architecture.
paper_relevance: separation of selection quality from rejection quality

experiments.hypothesis: Candidate-fit score geometry can reveal which supported misses are recoverable and whether a global similarity threshold can separate supported from near-domain unsupported requests.
experiments.interpretation: A single candidate-fit similarity threshold cannot provide both high supported recall and high near-domain rejection; rejection must use distinct negative/unknown capability evidence.

experiments.hypothesis: Per-route pairwise minimum-score thresholds can recover open-set safety while preserving the operation-narrow supported-routing gain.
experiments.failure_reason: Filter-then-rank route-local threshold semantics allowed a lower-ranked route to survive after the raw top route failed its own threshold, increasing executable false routes.

experiments.reason: Stacked on the weaker generic candidate pipeline. Frozen NLI hypothesis/grid was carried unchanged to #194; #192 results are not eligible for threshold selection.

experiments.failure_reason: Pairwise tool ranking crossed the 70% supported gate but did not provide an open-set capability boundary and badly missed rejection/false-route gates.
Conservative entailment thresholds improved unsupported rejection but collapsed supported recall; direct NLI is unsuitable as the operation selector/gate tested here.

experiments.purpose: Measure raw all-candidate BGE ranking ceiling and derive a development-only winner-only route-local threshold Pareto frontier without freezing behavior.
interpretation: All-candidate BGE raw ranking has substantially more supported headroom than the previous primary-tool/gated selector architecture.
Winner-first route-local score boundaries are sufficient in development simulation to satisfy accuracy, rejection, and false-route gates without a second negative model.
Recall width 4 remains too slow for the standing latency gate, so recall-width tuning is required before candidate freeze.

experiments.selection_rule: Choose the smallest width whose winner-only false-budget-12 frontier reaches >=70% supported exact-route, <=2% canonical false-route, >=96% near-domain rejection lower bound, and zero invalid plans/errors. If neither 2 nor 3 passes, retain 4.

experiments.failure_reason: Joint score+margin gating adds only ~0.35 percentage points at the same false-route budget, insufficient to justify a larger route-local tuning surface before width/latency optimization.

experiments.hypothesis: A width-2 bounded semantic recall plus score-only BGE rank-then-gate boundary can satisfy the 0.11 development quality gates without material latency regression.
experiments.failure_reason: The frozen width-2 winner-gate candidate crossed all preregistered quality/safety gates, but mean latency regressed from 531.031 ms to 765.187 ms (+44.09%) and p95 from 697.912 ms to 1836.868 ms (+163.19%). It must not advance to calibration.
experiments.next_action: Keep calibration/blind untouched. Activate #226 cheap action-only evidence diagnostics to find a lower-cost independent action signal and inform a separately preregistered behavior-changing candidate.

experiments.hypothesis: A cheap multilingual embedding over endpoint action names and trusted operation aliases can provide independent routing evidence at materially lower latency than BGE.
interpretation: The action-only signal is materially cheaper than BGE and carries independent operation information.
A global high-precision direct fast path has insufficient coverage to eliminate the BGE p95 bottleneck.
The next diagnostic should use action evidence to select inside the already-authorized width-2 candidate set, then score only one pair with BGE.

experiments.hypothesis: Use cheap action-only evidence to choose one already-authorized width-2 candidate, then score only one BGE pair to remove CPU tail latency.
experiments.failure_reason: Single-pair BGE materially improved mean/p95 latency, but the canonical <=2% false-route frontier retained only 65.36% supported exact-route accuracy.

experiments.hypothesis: Replace BGE inside width-2 authorized recall with cached action-only MiniLM embedding evidence.

integrity_events.reason: Projected frontier metrics could use valid_scored rather than full fixed-population denominators.

experiments.interpretation: Cheap embedding removed latency as the primary bottleneck, but using its winner score/margin as the open-set boundary collapsed supported recall.

experiments.hypothesis: Use one MiniLM query embedding against cached schema/domain and action-only route views to separate ranking evidence from open-set confidence.
experiments.interpretation: The architecture is extremely cheap, but MiniLM route representation capacity tops out near 75% raw exact and cannot support the production target.

experiments.hypothesis: Keep the dual-view routing architecture fixed and change only multilingual embedding backbone capacity.
experiments.interpretation: GTE and BGE-M3 both exceeded the 85% raw ranking target; BGE-M3 uniquely retained >83% exact under a <=1% false-route boundary at sub-200ms p95.

experiments.hypothesis: Let high-capacity GTE choose one winner and use one BGE cross-encoder pair only as the unsupported-operation rejector.
experiments.interpretation: Winner-only cross-encoder validation preserved acceptable latency but its relevance threshold rejected too many correct GTE winners.

experiments.failure_reason: One supported papers.citations case scored ~1.35e-7 below its frozen threshold; all planner/direct parity and safety gates passed, but the literal 960-correct frozen projection reproduced as 959. Candidate was not retuned and remained below the 85% final exact target.
Best preregistered strict point was 83.77% exact at 98.96% near-domain rejection and 0.93% false-route. No interpolation or out-of-grid retuning was permitted.

experiments.execution_condition: Execute only if #246 has no strict 85/97/1 pass.
experiments.base_selection_rule: Highest supported exact among preregistered #246 weights at budget 6 subject to rejection/false-route/error/latency gates; tie by lower p95 then lower schema weight.

experiments.hypothesis: Route-specific schema/action fusion weights can recover the remaining exact-route gap at embedding-only latency, while midpoint thresholds and conservative rounding remove sample-boundary numerical fragility observed in #245.

threshold_stability_policy.score_candidates: midpoints between adjacent unique winner scores

current_research_conclusion.supported_selection_problem: Accepted operation-fit selector materially reduces wrong-endpoint errors.
current_research_conclusion.unsupported_boundary_problem: Near-domain unsupported rejection does not improve when selector quality improves.
current_research_conclusion.global_threshold_problem: Candidate-fit similarity distributions overlap too strongly for one scalar threshold to satisfy both supported recall and unsupported rejection.
next_candidate_direction: keep routing authority bounded to registered authorized candidates
test action-only evidence as a selector inside width-2 rather than as a global direct acceptor
score one selected pair with BGE and derive route-local winner boundaries on DEV only
require paired mean and p95 non-regression before any confirmation freeze
retain typed negative/unknown evidence as a later branch only if the single-pair open-set frontier fails
current_research_conclusion.historical_negative_control: A generic none_of_the_above sentinel was already tested in the earlier empty-recall decision surface and removed as counterproductive. v0.11 negative-capability work must therefore use distinct typed boundary evidence rather than repeating that mechanism.
current_research_conclusion.route_local_filter_then_rank_problem: Per-option filter-then-rank thresholds can fall through from a rejected raw winner to a lower-ranked executable route; open-set safety requires winner-first gating or an equivalent no-fallback boundary.
current_research_conclusion.pairwise_tool_hierarchy_result: Pairwise stage-1 tool ranking can exceed the 70% supported development gate but does not solve unsupported-operation rejection.
current_research_conclusion.direct_nli_result: Direct multilingual entailment can raise rejection only by collapsing supported recall; it is rejected as the primary operation boundary.
current_research_conclusion.active_experiment: action-guided width-2 -> single-pair BGE diagnostic (#231 / PR #232)
current_research_conclusion.generic_no_route_sentinel_constraint: Do not reintroduce none_of_the_above as a competing pseudo-route; prior full-corpus evidence showed it was counterproductive. Negative capability must remain a distinct typed boundary signal or abstention rule.
current_research_conclusion.bounded_rerank_raw_ceiling: All-candidate contrastive BGE with recall width 4 reaches 90.71% raw supported top-1 on fresh v4 development.
current_research_conclusion.winner_only_boundary_result: At width 4, winner-only route-local score thresholds can reach 75.78% supported exact-route with 1.85% canonical false-route and 98.09% actual near-domain rejection.
current_research_conclusion.negative_model_status: A second negative/NLI model is not currently required to clear the accuracy/rejection/false-route DEV gates; latency is the immediate unresolved gate.
current_research_conclusion.latency_bottleneck: The frozen width-2 winner-gate candidate passed quality but failed paired latency at 765/1837 ms mean/p95 versus 531/698 ms baseline; unconditional BGE remains the immediate bottleneck.
current_research_conclusion.joint_margin_result: Adding route-local top margin to score thresholds yields only ~0.35 percentage points at the 12-false-route budget and is not selected for the immediate candidate.
current_research_conclusion.action_only_evidence_status: Action-only MiniLM reaches 73.00% raw supported top-route exact at ~13.84 ms mean / 15.51 ms p95, but global high-precision direct-accept coverage is too small to solve tail latency alone.

paper_reconstruction_checklist: Use only ledger entries with explicit tuning_eligible roles when discussing model/threshold selection.
Report rejected ablations, not only successful candidates.
Preserve run IDs, artifact IDs, SHA-256 digests, source revisions, and corpus hashes in supplementary material.
State when calibration/blind evidence became permanently consumed.
Include invalidated pre-result attempts and reasons without using their metrics.
Separate architectural authority claims from empirical performance claims.
